status: original Free public-teaching author packet; not Product-accepted, integrated, released or measured
outcome: Replay identical business events without changing revenue, apply newer full-state corrections to original order dates, and preserve the last good report after failed input or execution.
engine: author QA Python sqlite3 3.48.0; intended browser SQLite/SQL.js requires separate Engineering proof
data_policy: All names/IDs/dates/amounts fictional and intentionally Free/public
One fictional currency; integer cents only; no taxes, FX, partial refunds, line items, deletes or actual payment events
One event_id identifies one immutable business payload; any delivery_id identifies a physical receipt and is unique
Full replacement order state per strictly increasing source_version; gaps allowed; source version is the authority, not event/receipt time
order_date immutable per order; cancellation restates original order date and contributes zero on latest state
One distinct event per (order_id,source_version); conflicting payload/version/date rejects entire input before SQL
comparison: For nonempty outputs require exact header names/order, Python str/int types, integer cents and unordered row multiset including multiplicity. Empty results establish zero rows only in this author runner; integration must not claim metadata validated on empties.
preflight: Validate every raw row, unique delivery_id, nonblank IDs, positive integer version, real ISO date, UTC Z timestamp, status paid/cancelled, nonnegative integer cents, same event_id same immutable business payload, one distinct event per order/version, immutable order_date per order. Reject all violations with key/field/reason before grading. No SQL repair of bad source.
stage_flow: raw deliveries are visible before Run
stage1 accepted_events feeds the learner stage2 current_orders
stage2 learner output feeds stage3 daily_revenue
each stage has independent draft; upstream input/query change invalidates downstream preview/check, retains editor text
preflight source errors are separate from learner SQL error
complete valid same-input/same-query-revision chain may explicitly simulate publish
failed stage, worker cancellation/timeout, stale reply or conflict must retain last good report/run ID and keep unpublished intermediates marked preview
progressive_help: Hint1: Which identity changed on replay: receipt, business event, or order?
Hint2: Compare business payload columns to transport columns; then choose order state by source_version.
Hint3: Deduplicate per event_id, choose max source_version per order with a window or anti-join, and conditionally sum only paid current orders while retaining every represented date.
reveal: Deliberate worked SQL reveal is marked reviewed/assisted, never independent pass. A wrong attempt shows differing rows/counts, not a mastery score.
recovery: A conflict shows exact keys/reasons; corrected_retry removes D13 from conflict_event_payload. Failed query correction retains drafts. Restart confirms before discarding and restores baseline. Device-only drafts/run snapshots are not cloud/account progress.
production_consequence: At-least-once receipts plus a deterministic SELECT do not prove exactly-once writes. Immutable events support replay/audit at storage cost; latest-state tables speed reads but lose event history. Full recomputation suits small teaching data, while large real pipelines require bounded keyed updates, transactional publication, monitoring and rollback. Unknown source-version authority is escalation, not a guessed timestamp winner.
runtime_not_proven: safe read-only statement boundary and finite row/size limits
typed materialization of each learner stage
draft/run revision guards and last-good atomic simulated publication
cloud pipeline, backend transaction, account persistence and learner effect
